title: The time has come for big changes to improve research funding
content:
by Peter Kolarz

The competitive research funding system is at a breaking point. Innovations to address ongoing problems are needed on a grander scale than ever before, but even this will not suffice to fix a struggling system. What we need is a whole system transformation.
